# BetterHelp

> BetterHelp is the largest online therapy platform connecting users with 32,000+ licensed therapists for convenient, affordable mental health care via telehealth.

BetterHelp offers professional online therapy with licensed therapists (LPC, LMFT, LCSW, PsyD, PhD credentials), therapist matching, insurance acceptance, HSA/FSA eligibility, and comprehensive mental health resources. The platform serves clients across the United States with flexible subscription and pay-per-session options.

## Key Topics

- Online Therapy
- Licensed Therapists
